finding: Stage 1 fails the accepted input-selection/subject-matching law. A public-seam CalculationRequestV1 for subject NVDA and D011 was materialised successfully from raw R034/R035 bindings whose subject_instrument and projected observations were AAPL. The resulting occurrence was labelled NVDA with result 101 while its raw lineage identified the AAPL observations. Accepted brief clause 8.1 requires single-instrument calculations to use the same canonical subject/instrument identity across all required inputs and clause 17 requires fail-closed behaviour when matching prerequisites are not satisfied.

independent_evidence.note: The existing green proof does not exercise this cross-subject public-seam case. Review stopped at the first failed semantic invariant.

repair_proposition: The Stage-1 input-selection path must enforce the accepted row/policy subject, contract, basket and temporal matching law before calculation. In particular, a single-instrument request must not materialise from raw bindings/observations for another subject. Add authority-derived proof that discriminates this mismatch, repair only the Stage-1 selection path required to make that proposition true, and return a fresh exact Stage-1 candidate.
